仅在车辆数据库变化时，将游戏资源 gamedbRC.slt 发送至 forzam: Only when the car database changes, send the game resource gamedbRC.slt to forzamods.dev. Content sync never reads or uploads player saves.
新系列赛必须已存在于游戏资源及所连接存档中。未知存档格式会停止对应编辑，仍需客户: New series must exist in the game resources and connected save. Unknown save formats stop the affected editor and require a compatibility update.

数据包不包含玩家存档。新车型需要完整的原厂部件数据；只有名称和 ID 的列表不能: Packs contain no player saves. New cars require complete stock-part data; a list of names and IDs alone cannot add cars.
